title: Import statement
intro: Load a CSV or Excel statement from your bank. Your data never leaves your device.

file.heading: Choose the statement
file.label: Statement file (CSV or XLSX)
file.hint: Supported formats: CSV and Excel (.xlsx), up to 20 MB. The file is read on your device.
file.drop: You can also drag the file here.
file.dropActive: Drop the file to read it
file.sampleHint: Fictitious BBVA statement with 50 made-up transactions.

uiErrors.unexpected: The file could not be read. Please try again.
uiErrors.sampleUnavailable: The sample statement could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

detection.heading: Preview
detection.remembered: Format recognised: using the mapping you confirmed last time for this bank.
detection.lowConfidence: Detection is uncertain: check what each column contains before importing.
detection.headerRow: Header on row {{row}} of the file.
detection.noHeader: No header found: columns were inferred from their content.

mapping.heading: Columns
mapping.intro: Tell us what each column contains. Changes update the preview immediately.

convention.label: How amounts are written
convention.hint: Signed: expenses carry a "-". Debit and credit: charges subtract and deposits add.

mapping.updated: Preview updated: {{valid}} valid rows and {{errors}} with errors.

dates.heading: Ambiguous dates
dates.text: Every date can be read as day/month or month/day (for example, 03/04/2026). They will be read as day/month, the format Spanish banks use.
dates.confirm: I confirm the dates are in day/month/year format (dd/mm/yyyy)

warnings.heading: Check these warnings
warnings.ambiguousAmount: Line {{line}}: the amount "{{value}}" is ambiguous; it is read with a thousands dot (Spanish format).
warnings.duplicatesNote: Transactions you already have are detected when you confirm and are not duplicated.

table.caption: Preview of the first {{count}} rows of the statement
table.counts: In the first rows read: {{valid}} valid and {{errors}} with errors.
table.unavailable: Fill in the required columns to see the preview.

account.heading: Destination account
account.label: Save the transactions in
account.loadError: The accounts could not be loaded.

blockers.heading: Before importing:
blockers.accountName: Enter a name for the new account.
blockers.accounts: Wait for the accounts to load.

status.previewReady: Preview ready: {{valid}} valid rows and {{errors}} with errors.

summary.heading: Import complete
summary.announce: Imported {{inserted}} transactions, skipped {{duplicates}} duplicates and categorised {{categorized}} by rules.
summary.nothingNew: There were no new transactions: the whole statement was already imported.
